CoachingSetup.title: CoachingSetup
CoachingSetup.description: Active coaching center configuration created by the Coaching Management App.

name.description: Display name of the coaching center

isActive.description: Whether this coaching setup is currently active

CoachingClass.title: CoachingClass
CoachingClass.description: Configured class offering with full-year fee and optional batches.

fullYearFee.description: Read-only annual fee configured by the institute

batches.description: Optional list of batch names (e.g., Morning, Evening)

isActive.description: Whether admissions are open for this class

BlockedProfile.title: BlockedProfile
BlockedProfile.description: Google profile permanently restricted from submitting new admissions until unblocked by an admin.

googleUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the blocked Google user

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Self-registered student admission record stored in the shared students collection.

classId.description: Selected class document ID from coaching_setup/{setupId}/classes

batch.description: Selected batch name or null when class has no batches

googleUid.description: Verified Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid

currentDueDate.description: Always null on initial web admission

firstDueDate.description: Always null on initial web admission

receipts.description: Always an empty array on initial web admission

/coaching_setup/{setupId}/classes/{class.description: Available coaching classes, full-year fees, and optional batches

/coaching_setup/{setupId}/blocked_profil.description: Google profiles blocked from submitting online admissions

/students/{studentId}.description: Self-registered student admissions shared with the Coaching Management Android App
